svg.title: A treasury that keeps itself solvent
svg.desc: A bench-top paying machine. A strongbox holds the company's money; a sight glass on its front shows the level and the reserve floor. A track leaves the box through a gate and drops coins into a row of payee trays: one tray paid, one being paid now, one due. The gate is driven from the agent's card reader, but only through a governor dial whose stop pin the owner set: the daily cap. The owner's phone lies in a dock, cabled to the only lock on the box; nothing else opens it.
